column1: # qtmlClient.lib members the exe interleaves among the runtime objects, by the exe VA of the
# member's first linked function (vendor/quicktime/linked.tsv). tools/qtorder.py extracts each
# from vendor/quicktime/qtmlClient.lib at link time and linkorder.py --qtmembers lists it as a
# plain object at that VA (a library member lands at the end of .text wherever the library sits).
# The optional third column renames member symbols: the exe holds QuickTime's own DisposeGWorld,
# GetPixBaseAddr, GetGWorldDevice and GetGWorldPixMap beside the port's same-named emulation,
# so the original linked one of the two under other names; the tree's callers of QuickTime's
